svg.title: Contribution calendar
svg.desc: 349 contributions over 53 weeks, one cell per day. Busiest day was 3 September 2026 with 36 contributions. 299 days were quiet. Shading runs in four bands by daily count: 1, 2–3, 4–5 and 6+.
svg.text: bands are the quartiles of this year's active days, so one outlier cannot flatten the scale
